Method of Attack: Monitoring mobile devices without user knowledge
Collecting sensitive user information like location and online activity
Requiring jailbroken devices to install, exposing to security vulnerabilities
Allowing removal of app icons to hide presence
Failure to keep collected data confidential and safe
Data exfiltration via cloud storage breaches using unencrypted and obfuscated credentials
Impacted Systems: Mobile devices of children and employees
Attack Vector: Use of unencrypted cloud storage credentials
Remote online dashboard access to monitored device screens
Indicators of Compromise: Breach of cloud storage in February 2017 and February 2018
Harvested data including login usernames, encrypted passwords, text messages, GPS locations, contacts, and photos
Websites for the monitoring products remained online after sales stopped
